request-prompt: Increase the size of the infinite scrolling recommendation feed ('feed-card' sections) and remove the header categories menu since I rely entirely on personalized feed recommendations anyway.
goal: I love relying on the platform's personalized homepage recommendations and algorithmic feeds to passively discover new and interesting content.
jobs: I want to discover and watch recommended videos to entertain myself during my free time
I want to search for a specific video, topic, or content creator using keywords
I want to watch live-streamed content, such as esports matches or gaming streams
I want to browse specific entertainment categories like anime, movies, documentaries, or games
I want to log into my account to access my viewing history, saved favorites, and private messages
I want to upload my own videos to share them with the Bilibili community
I want to check the trending list to see what topics and videos are popular right now
I want to view the latest updates and posts from the content creators I follow

preference-pairs.a: I enjoy a highly interactive and social viewing experience, actively participating in bullet chats (danmaku), comment sections, and community forums.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer a clean, distraction-free viewing experience, usually disabling bullet comments and ignoring social features to focus purely on the video content itself.

preference-pairs.a: I love relying on the platform's personalized homepage recommendations and algorithmic feeds to passively discover new and interesting content.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer having direct control over my navigation, always using search engines or specific category menus to find exactly what I have in mind.

preference-pairs.a: I view video platforms as a creative outlet and a place to upload my own content, build a fanbase, and manage my creative metrics.
preference-pairs.b: I treat video platforms purely as a consumption tool, with absolutely no interest in creating, uploading, or managing content of my own.

preference: I love relying on the platform's personalized homepage recommendations and algorithmic feeds to passively discover new and interesting content.
